title: Dereth Town Tour - Shoushi scratch

shots.standingOrder: Hold high on the western hill and pan slowly right across the walled courtyards of Shoushi until the green pagoda settles in frame.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (classic.pan). From 12 m above the wooded hill 230 m west of town (z 68), a slow 42 deg pan right: from the five-storey spire tower and the northern halls across the grid of low Yaosai walls and green-roofed compounds, landing on the octagon pagoda (Spire of Serenity) just left of centre; the low western sun is behind the camera, so walls and roofs are front-lit with long shadows. shots.standingOrder: Bank in low over the western field and shoot straight through the roofed west gate of the old Yaosai wall into the town.
shots.notes: FPV GAP (fpv.fpv-gap). A low banked approach over the western field from the south-west, aligned 10 m out, then straight through the roofed west gate of the old Yaosai wall 1.6 m above the ground and 30 m on into town between the dome hall and the two-storey hall; sun behind the camera. shots.standingOrder: Stand quietly in the corner of the walled court and drift toward the fountain and the Life Stone with a gentle handheld breath.
shots.notes: WATER + MAGIC + FLAME (classic.handheld). Standing quietly in the north-east corner of the walled court at eye height, a gentle handheld push of 1.5 m toward the Life Stone (sparkle column), the fountain spraying in the right foreground, a lantern flickering between them and the flowering court tree and the well beside; the south gate roof and the hall beyond close the frame.
